summary: Final verification of Public Surfaces Usability Pass on CleanCheckoutV2 buyer checkout. Used the fresh QA link (link_id 260, $25 USD, 24h). Executed all 6 requested tests (desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844) in a single Playwright session. Selected Litecoin/LTC and reached the awaiting-payment state on both viewports. All required data-testid elements render, wallet deep-link uses correct crypto URI scheme (litecoin:...?amount=0.50136371), copy button flips to 'Copied', sticky mobile bar present with 48px buttons, no horizontal overflow, all interactive targets >=44px, no network 4xx/5xx, no React runtime errors — only 2 dev-only PropTypes warnings from MUI Box in PanelShell.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy → Copied transition causes a minor layout shift (>2px) in the button's bounding box due to text-width change. Not visually jarring but violates strict 'no layout jump' criterion. Suggest reserving min-width or using fixed-width label.

issues: React dev warning: 'Invalid prop `children` supplied to ForwardRef(Box), expected a ReactNode' — logged twice. Indicates a falsy/undefined child (or an array containing an invalid element) being passed to an MUI Box inside PanelShell. Dev-only PropTypes warning, not visible in production build but should be cleaned up.

TEST6_console_and_network.warning_summary: MUI Box invalid `children` proptype in PanelShell (CleanCheckoutV2.tsx:3422)

action_items: Optional: reserve min-width on [data-testid=clean-checkout-copy-address] (and copy-amount) so 'Copy' → 'Copied' text change does not shift the button bounds.

Optional: fix the MUI Box `children` PropTypes warning in CleanCheckoutV2.tsx around line 3422 (PanelShell) — likely a conditionally-rendered falsy child (e.g. `{cond && <X/>}` where cond is `0`/`''` or an array containing `undefined`).
critical_code_review_comments: CleanCheckoutV2.tsx is very large (>3400 lines based on stack trace + refs to lines 1442/1560/1657/3422). Strongly consider splitting into subcomponents (PanelShell, CheckoutStatusTimeline, StickyActionBar, QRPanel) into separate files for maintainability.
PropTypes warning suggests some children arrays contain undefined/null — always guard with `? :` returning `null` or use React.Fragment sparingly to avoid MUI Box receiving non-ReactNode arrays.
seed_data_creation: None. Only one pending payment attempt on the merchant's own QA link (as explicitly permitted by request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Usability Pass on CleanCheckoutV2 fully verified on live preview using fresh link_id 260. All data-testids present, wallet deep-link scheme correct (litecoin: with amount), sticky bar and touch-target sizing meet 44px spec, no network failures, no React runtime errors. Only cleanup items are (a) minor Copy-button width shift and (b) MUI Box children PropTypes warning at CleanCheckoutV2.tsx:3422.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bug found. The two dev-only PropTypes warnings in PanelShell (CleanCheckoutV2.tsx:3422) are caused by rendering an invalid child (undefined / boolean / array with undefined items) inside an MUI Box; mitigation is to coerce conditional renders to `null` explicitly and audit the children array around line 3422.
